name: @archlast/forge-runtime
description: The archlast-forge engine: schema, functions, the reactive server, and the testing library.

scripts.typecheck: bun check && bun check -p test-types && bun check -p test/fixture-nest && bun check -p test/fixture-nest-io && bun check -p test/fixture-nest-sdl && bun check -p test/fixture-webhooks && bun check -p test/fixture-root && bun check -p test/fixture-helmet && bun check -p test/fixture-auth-plugins
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/server/index.ts ./src/server/child.ts ./src/server/telemetry/worker.ts ./src/server/waf/worker.ts ./src/testing.ts ./src/nest.ts ./src/nest-websockets.ts ./src/nest-microservices.ts ./src/nest-graphql.ts ./src/nest-rpc.ts ./src/nest-webhooks.ts ./src/auth-plugins.ts ./src/auth-plugins/oauth-provider.ts ./src/auth-plugins/api-key.ts ./src/auth-plugins/passkey.ts ./src/auth-plugins/sso.ts ./src/auth-plugins/scim.ts ./src/auth-plugins/i18n.ts --root ./src --outdir ./dist --target bun --splitting --packages external && bun build ./src/forge-rpc/index.ts --outfile ./dist/forge-rpc/index.js --target bun --packages external --minify && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
